content: "Create an image of a diverse group of people of various ages and ethnicities standing together, each one holding a piece of a large puzzle. The puzzle pieces fit together to form a heart shape, symbolizing unity and collaboration. In the background, a soft, glowing light emanates from the completed heart, casting a warm and inviting glow over the scene. The overall feel should be uplifting and inspiring, communicating the message that every contributor plays a crucial role in completing the bigger picture of support and community."
